explanation: rootArgCount counts the roots with multiplicity whose argument, normalised to [0,2π), lies in a closed interval [α,β] ⊆ [0,2π]. M is (Σ|a_i|)/√(|a_0||a_d|), and n is the support size, all as on erdosproblems.com/990; a₀ ≠ 0 is assumed so that M is defined. Hayman proved that the discrepancy is ≤ n − 1. The statement matches for all intervals [α,β] ⊆ [0,2π], with n = support size. Faithful.
